WITH Numbers AS (
  SELECT 90 as A, 2 as B UNION ALL
  SELECT 50, 8 UNION ALL
  SELECT 60, 6 UNION ALL
  SELECT 50, 10
)
SELECT
  A,
  B,
  CASE A
    WHEN 90 THEN 'red'
    WHEN 50 THEN 'blue'
    ELSE 'green'
    END
    AS result
FROM Numbers

WITH Numbers AS (
  SELECT 90 as A, 2 as B UNION ALL
  SELECT 50, 6 UNION ALL
  SELECT 20, 10
)
SELECT
  A,
  B,
  CASE
    WHEN A > 60 THEN 'red'
    WHEN B = 6 THEN 'blue'
    ELSE 'green'
    END
    AS result
FROM Numbers
